implementation_step: Create pure module and CLI entry point: validate_payload(payload) returns structured status JSON; CLI reads payload JSON and writes status JSON.
expected_result: Validator can run in tests and from shell without changing semantics.
risk: CLI behavior may drift from import behavior if not sharing one function.

implementation_step: Represent F01-F22 as FieldSpec records with field_id, JSON pointer, type, required modes, predicate adapter, and blocker reason.
expected_result: Predicate gates are auditable against the schema contract.
risk: Manual transcription error from schema into code.

implementation_step: Implement JSON pointer extraction with separate missing-field and present-invalid-field outcomes.
expected_result: Diagnostics can report missing_fields, invalid_fields, and first_failed_predicate.
risk: Nested object edge cases may collapse missing and invalid states.

implementation_step: Implement conservative predicate adapters for stable identifiers, exact locators, scalar units/dimensionless status, structure hashes, pair lists, normalization formula, execution provenance, and tolerance objects.
expected_result: Each F-predicate can be mechanically evaluated without claiming material validity.
risk: Predicates such as implementation_matches_formula may require executable artifact checks beyond syntax.

implementation_step: Resolve target modes reported_context, candidate_exact_replay, diagnosed_mismatch, admitted_exact, plus exact_certified_observable as strict admitted_exact alias.
expected_result: Schema and oracle fixtures can use one target-mode evaluator.
risk: Alias handling could accidentally loosen exact-mode gates.

implementation_step: Retire PARTIAL_CONTEXT_ONLY as an emitted terminal. Map legacy PARTIAL_CONTEXT_ONLY target requests to BLOCK with DEPRECATED_PARTIAL_CONTEXT_ONLY diagnostic.
expected_result: Undefined partial-context terminal cannot become a silent upgrade path.
risk: Downstream consumers expecting the old label may need migration.

implementation_step: Apply guards G01-G05 before status promotion: no scalar-only exactness, no DOI-only context pass, context is not exact, current Srivastava exact BLOCK, mismatch requires complete replay.
expected_result: Forbidden upgrades remain blocked even with intent labels or partial proof objects.
risk: Guard order mistakes could hide the more useful first_failed_predicate.

implementation_step: Implement final comparison only after F01-F22 pass, using reported_scalar.scalar, recomputed_value, and predeclared abs/rel tolerance.
expected_result: Only complete bundles can emit DIAGNOSED_MISMATCH or ADMITTED_EXACT.
risk: Tolerance semantics may be ambiguous when both abs and rel tolerances are present.

implementation_step: Create fixtures for the eight A expected cases: null/empty, scalar-only, DOI-only, Srivastava summary, context-only, replay-ready no recompute, complete mismatch, complete match.
risk: Fixture simplification may fail to exercise realistic predicate adapters.

implementation_step: Create oracle-derived fixtures for no-silent-upgrade and mismatch cases, including numeric-closeness-only, narrative-provenance-only, executor-quality-only, failed structure, failed cardinality, failed raw sum, and failed normalization.
expected_result: Adversarial transition coverage prevents silent promotions.
risk: The oracle uses WARN_UNRESOLVED_SCALAR as a warning, not an A-schema terminal.

implementation_step: Parametrize tests over fixtures and assert terminal_status, first_failed_predicate, missing_fields, invalid_fields, and diagnostics.
expected_result: Implementation can be verified against both contracts.
risk: Overly brittle diagnostics may make valid refactors difficult.

implementation_step: Document emitted statuses, retired PARTIAL_CONTEXT_ONLY handling, fixture schema, CLI usage, and forbidden claims.
expected_result: Future implementers know context pass is not exact admission.
risk: Documentation can become stale if generated status names change.
